note: Current working-squad portraits only; separate from the 182-player probable IPL 2027 auction candidate pool. Three exact user-supplied 2026 SRH portraits are stored locally. Other photos are direct image URLs from official franchise/league or established cricket profile sources; links are source-tracked. If a remote source fails, the app shows initials instead of another player photo.
